serverInfo.name: @guardbee/mcp-ssl-inspector
serverInfo.description: MCP server that inspects TLS certificates, cipher suites, and protocol configurations for any domain

tools.name: inspect_ssl
tools.description: Inspect TLS certificate, cipher suite, and protocol configuration for a single domain

host.description: Domain name or IP to inspect (e.g. example.com)

checkHsts.description: Also check HSTS header via HTTP HEAD (default: true)

tools.name: inspect_ssl_bulk
tools.description: Inspect TLS configuration for multiple domains in parallel

hosts.description: List of domain names to inspect

port.description: Port to use for all domains (default: 443)

tools.name: check_cert_expiry
tools.description: Check certificate expiry for one or more domains and highlight certificates expiring soon

warnDays.description: Warn if expiring within this many days (default: 30)

tools.name: get_cert_info
tools.description: Get detailed certificate information for a domain including fingerprint, SANs, and issuer chain
